story: Anthropic has released Claude Haiku 5.5, a small AI model it calls its fastest and cheapest yet, at much lower prices.
text: Why it matters: Companies and developers running high-volume AI tasks such as support chat can cut costs, but the honest doubt is that the new tokenizer may use more billed units per task, so real savings could be smaller than the prices suggest.
